description: A ground-level photograph depicting an agricultural landscape under a partly cloudy sky. In the foreground, green crops are visible, actively being irrigated by multiple sprinklers spraying water across the field. In the midground, there are other cultivated fields, some appearing fallow or tilled, and a dark-roofed building. The background features a rolling, vegetated hillside with several tall electricity transmission pylons visible on the horizon. The scene illustrates land use dedicated to crop cultivation reliant on irrigation systems.
